policy: Same corrected original wording, cached assets and frozen accepted scan poses on both sides. Shared set defaults are selected from prior development studies, not per-card geometry. Reserved examples have been inspected repeatedly and are not independent validation. Inline glyph circles/advances are unscaled. All 316 printings render, including 34 rejected scan poses which remain unscored. Default-width layout compatibility covers every frozen input; Oracle fitting covers left/original/Oracle alignment policies. Text-fit indices are regional similarity measures, not percent-correct or complete-set certification.
limitations: Uncircled historical generic activation costs need a broader source-style review.
Residual original punctuation/verse breaks, font weight and short-heading placement remain open.
The Dark keeps its earlier shared candidate; new font proportions were rejected. Remaining regressions stay in the review queue.
